# Space

A distinguishable space within or associated with a property — rooms, outbuildings, storage areas, and outdoor zones where assets may be located. Maps to schema:Place in JSON-LD

Source: [`v3/space.json`](../../v3/space.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/space.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this space within the INHERIT document |
| `propertyId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Property.id that contains or is associated with this space |
| `containedInSpaceId` | `string` or `null` (uuid) | | Reference to another Space.id that physically contains this space — a loft inside a house, a shelving bay inside a storage room. Enables the recursive Property → Space → Space → item chain a room-by-room listing walk produces. Absent or null means this space sits directly in the Property |
| `spaceType` | one of `living_room`, `dining_room`, `kitchen`, `kitchen_diner`, `breakfast_room`, `family_room`, `sitting_room`, `drawing_room`, `conservatory`, `sunroom`, `snug`, `bedroom`, `guest_bedroom`, `nursery`, `spare_room`, `dressing_room`, `bathroom`, `en_suite`, `shower_room`, `wet_room`, … (+81 more) or `string` | yes | The type of space. Use x-inherit- prefix for cultural or jurisdiction-specific space types not covered by the core enum |
| `name` | `string` | | Display name for this space. Allows personalisation beyond the spaceType label |
| `floor` | one of `basement`, `ground`, `first`, `second`, `third`, `fourth`, `fifth`, `attic`, `mezzanine`, `other` | | Which floor this space is on, if applicable |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional notes about this space — access instructions, security details, storage conditions |
| `images` | array of [Media](common/media.md) | | Photographs of this space — overview, contents, access points |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
